title: What Killed the Dinosaurs?
description:
This thin line of clay marks the end of the dinosaurs.

In a cliff in Italy, fossil shells nearly disappear above a thin clay layer. In 1980, scientists found a rare metal from space in the clay.

Sources: Alvarez et al. (1980), Science 208; Walter Alvarez (1997).
